HELP_LINES: Lookout's slate: ; studies a place without spending a watch; a pointing hand turns the same glass.
Witness roll: O records visible workers, beasts, duties, stores, and immediate dangers.
Quartermaster's hand: F tests nearby material; work spends one watch, while Escape leaves it untouched.
Regional ledger: Z opens the work account, its testimony, and the changes already gathering.
Courier's field card: arrows, HJKL, and YUBN carry a traveller across the ground; the sightline travels with them.
Pathfinder's cord: T follows a witnessed destination one ordinary step at a time; any mark cuts the cord.
Deck orders: Enter or E handles what is near. A sets an attack line. G braces, reloads, or listens.
Gangplank order: E steps ashore from Jomon. Tab presents the tug or a nearby interior; E boards a regional conveyance.
Chart key: @ courier, a ally, v visitor, c/M witnesses, h/g/x/b threats, X claimant, R cargo, C sealed store.
Warned ground: a reversed ! is an observed prepared blow; a courier standing in it is marked the same way.
Survey key: ~ water, # wall, + door, <> stair, ^ roof, & working control, O drop, d weak floor.
Cabin custom: speak beside a person to change courier or invite aid; C consults the tavern support, P sets a chart course.
Pack ledger: I opens a pack or locker to shift, turn, pass, carry, bind, or set aside a physical thing.
Courier's marks: P opens learned disciplines; D brings spellwork and shrine vigil to hand; W calls for work and flasks.
A quiet, near shore and light pack draw little notice; time, distance, noise, and valuables do otherwise.
Bright ground lies in present sight; dim ground is remembered; blank ground has not yet been witnessed.
Brace against readable intent. Smoke spoils aim. Mud, water, machinery, height, and walls decide the footing.
Master's leave book: Q asks for departure. Escape folds the current paper without leaving a mark.
